name: comp-310
title: Sale Countdown Banner
description: A full-width dark promo bar with a Black Friday headline, a live countdown in divided cells, a white Buy now button and a close X. It removes itself when the timer runs out.
use: A time-limited sale needs a visible countdown next to a buy action.
avoid: It hides itself when the timer ends and the end date lives in code, so a new sale needs a rebuild.
a11y: Close is labelled and the ticket badge hidden, but the changing seconds are not announced to screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-width dark strip: a bold sale headline over one muted line on the left, then a tinted rounded box split into hour, minute and second cells, a white Buy now pill and a faint X. A ticket badge is cut off at the left edge.
behaves: The countdown drops by one second on each tick; when it reaches zero the whole bar removes itself. The X hides it early, and the X brightens on hover.
customise: Headline, description and button label are hardcoded, and the sale end date is a module-level constant.
weight: light: One strip and a once-per-second state update that stops when it is dismissed.
